# `quote_requests` — module reference

Rendered from the module's own manifest, and from nothing written by hand. What the module *does* is [its own page](../modules/quote_requests.md).

## Activation

An operator switches this module on and off on **/platform/modules**. The choice is the setting `quote_requests.enabled`, and it defaults to **on**.
